description:
Move the composition of the `query available` filters and its priority order into the domain, so the property has a pure owner before its subprocess re-proofs are cut.

## Background

`crates/jit/src/domain/queries.rs` owns the pure query filters, tested there (21 unit tests) and in `crates/jit/tests/fast_issue/domain_queries_tests.rs` (10). `query available` composes its filters and priority order in the commands layer (`crates/jit/src/commands/query.rs:122-148`), and `crates/jit/src/commands/issue.rs:800` repeats the sort. The composed property has no domain owner and is proven only by subprocess tests in `crates/jit/tests/cli_query_graph/query_tests.rs`. Domain code is pure and I/O-free.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One pure function in `domain/queries.rs` takes issues and the available-work filter and returns the available issues in priority order. `query available` and the claim path both call it, and neither sorts on its own.
- [hard] REQ-02: Unit tests and a property-based test in `domain/queries.rs` own filter composition and ordering, including ties and each filter combination the command accepts.
- [hard] REQ-03: `query available` output is unchanged.
title: Available-work filtering and priority order become a pure domain query
